text_block_list.text:
Summer camp begins, and Голд Шипп is
hyped to
the max for this big
adventure—complete with
sleepovers
and hijinks!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But even the mighty must fall... She exhausts herself and falls asleep en route. The beach is right there! Get up, Голд Шип!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
